description: Arkheionx paid readiness offer catalog. Paid work is readiness support, not a formal audit.

offers.name: Arkheionx Readiness Snapshot
offers.audience: DeFi founders and small teams that need a quick pre-audit readiness picture.
offers.description: Small, fast readiness engagement that runs Arkheionx on an authorized repository and turns obvious blockers into a short report and issue plan.
offers.duration: 1-2 business days after intake and repository access are ready.
safety_boundaries: Local/static repository review only
No private keys, mnemonics, RPC secrets, or API tokens
No public disclosure of unpatched vulnerability details
Findings are readiness signals and review recommendations
recommended_for: Small teams that need a concise blocker list
Repositories that already build and test locally
not_recommended_for: Teams seeking exploit development or live-target testing

offers.name: Arkheionx Pre-Audit Sprint
offers.audience: Teams preparing for a formal audit, contest, or bug bounty launch.
offers.description: Three-to-five day guided readiness workflow that turns scanner output into prioritized remediation, invariant/test planning, and audit handoff artifacts.
offers.duration: 3-5 business days, with optional follow-up calibration when scoped.
required_inputs: Known limitations and open security questions
safety_boundaries: Authorized repository evaluation only
Local/static analysis and human-guided readiness review
No deployed-contract scanning
No exploit payload generation
recommended_for: Teams within 1-4 weeks of audit intake
Protocols with missing invariants or documentation gaps
Teams that want GitHub-native remediation tasks

offers.name: Contest Readiness Pack
offers.audience: Teams preparing for an authorized audit contest, bug bounty launch, or public security review.
offers.description: Repository and documentation readiness package focused on scope clarity, researcher onboarding, and obvious audit blockers before external review.
offers.duration: 2-4 business days depending on repository and documentation size.
required_inputs: Candidate in-scope and out-of-scope contract list
Known issues and limitations safe to document
safety_boundaries: No endorsement or affiliation with named contest platforms
No live-target testing
No exploit steps for active systems
Respect platform and responsible disclosure rules
recommended_for: Teams opening an authorized external review
Maintainers that want cleaner scope docs
not_recommended_for: Unpatched vulnerability disclosure in public channels

offers.name: GitHub Action Setup
offers.audience: Teams that want Arkheionx readiness checks in CI.
offers.description: Implementation support for adding the Arkheionx GitHub Action, artifacts, SARIF, config, and safe threshold guidance to an authorized repository.
offers.duration: 1-2 business days after repository workflow access is ready.
not_included: Remote issue creation unless explicitly scoped
safety_boundaries: No GitHub token collection by Arkheionx docs or scripts
No external API integration beyond user-controlled GitHub workflows
Issue creation remains opt-in and token-scoped
No network dependency for default scan
recommended_for: Repositories that want SARIF and report artifacts
not_recommended_for: Repositories without authorization to install workflows

offers.name: Ecosystem Readiness Pilot
offers.audience: Grant programs, accelerators, hackathons, and ecosystems supporting multiple authorized DeFi builders.
offers.description: Pilot-only multi-repository readiness review across a small set of authorized repositories to surface common readiness gaps and calibration notes.
not_included: Customer or adoption claims without permission
safety_boundaries: Pilot only before v1.3.0 Ecosystem Pack refinement
No public naming without explicit permission
No private code or vulnerability disclosure in public artifacts
No live-chain behavior
recommended_for: Grant programs that want repeatable Markdown artifacts
Accelerators with several authorized DeFi repos
